tasks.title: Complete Domain Model Foundation
tasks.description: Audit existing domain types (commitment, decision, intervention, goal, task, types, errors) for gaps. Ensure all state machines are complete, validation is thorough, and no zero-value patterns leak. Add any missing types (e.g. Assignment full validation). Add table-driven unit tests for all types.

tasks.title: Complete Ports & Interfaces
tasks.description: Audit ports/interfaces.go for completeness. Add any missing repository methods or filter fields needed by pipeline workflows. Ensure all outbound client interfaces (Mnemos, Chronos, Praxis) have transport-safe DTOs. Document interface contracts in code comments.

tasks.title: Complete Memory Backend
tasks.description: Audit memory store implementation. Ensure all repositories implement their full interface. Add thread-safety if missing. Add store-level integration test that exercises all CRUD and filter combinations.

tasks.title: Complete SQLite Backend
tasks.description: Audit SQLite store: schema creation, migrations, encoding/decoding, all repository methods. Ensure JSON fields are handled correctly. Fix any missing repository implementations. Add SQLite-specific integration tests.

tasks.title: Complete PostgreSQL Backend
tasks.description: Audit PostgreSQL store: schema, migrations, encoding, all repository methods. Ensure parity with SQLite. Add PostgreSQL-specific integration tests. Verify connection pooling and cleanup.

tasks.title: Store Parity & Integration Tests
tasks.description: Create a shared integration test suite that runs against all three backends (memory, sqlite, postgres). Ensure identical behavior for filters, pagination limits, ordering, and JSON field round-tripping. Fix any parity gaps discovered.

tasks.title: Complete Risk Engine
tasks.description: Audit risk engine for correctness. Ensure all scoring factors are implemented and clamped. Add memory/recency factor hooks (even if MVP ignores them). Add comprehensive unit tests for edge cases (nil DueAt, multiple signals, score clamping).

tasks.title: Complete Intervention Engine
tasks.description: Audit intervention engine policy. Ensure thresholds and automation confidence logic are correct. Add tests for all intervention types. Ensure human-readable messages are well-formed.

tasks.title: Complete Extraction Pipeline
tasks.description: Audit Extractor workflow. Ensure error handling, audit Decision creation, and confidence thresholding are robust. Add tests for partial failures (some saves fail). Ensure clock injection works correctly.

tasks.title: Complete Evaluation Pipeline
tasks.description: Audit Evaluator workflow. Ensure signal lookback, memory fetching, risk update, decision recording, and intervention emission all work. Add tests for soft-fail behavior on Mnemos/Chronos errors. Ensure batch limiting works.

tasks.title: Complete Direct Kernel
tasks.description: Implement DirectKernel fully: convert Intervention SuggestedAction into Praxis ActionRequest, invoke Praxis.Execute, capture result, synthesize EvidenceRecord. Add unit tests with fake PraxisClient.

tasks.title: Complete Axi Kernel
tasks.description: Implement AxiKernel using axi-go: wrap Praxis calls in effect-gated approval, budgets, and tamper-evident evidence chain. Map axi-go evidence to kernel EvidenceRecord. Add tests with fake axi-go client.

tasks.title: Complete Scripted LLM Extractor
tasks.description: Ensure the scripted CommitmentExtractor implementation is deterministic and covers all test scenarios. Add test cases for edge inputs (empty text, no commitments, malformed hints).

tasks.title: Define gRPC Service Layer
tasks.description: Create protobuf definitions for Extract, Evaluate, ListCommitments, GetDecision, ListInterventions, ResolveIntervention. Generate Go code. Define request/response DTOs with validation tags.

tasks.title: Implement gRPC Server
tasks.description: Implement the gRPC service handlers. Wire dependencies (pipelines, repositories) into the server. Add interceptors for logging and auth. Handle error mapping to gRPC status codes.

tasks.title: Implement HTTP Gateway
tasks.description: Add gRPC-Gateway or equivalent to expose REST endpoints alongside gRPC. Ensure OpenAPI documentation is generated. Map HTTP methods and paths correctly.

tasks.title: Implement Worker / Scheduler
tasks.description: Build a background worker that runs the evaluation loop on a configurable tick. Implement graceful shutdown (drain in-flight evaluations, close stores). Add metrics emission for each tick. Add health check endpoint.

tasks.title: Set Up Observability
tasks.description: Add structured logging (slog) with correlation IDs. Add OpenTelemetry tracing spans for Extract and Evaluate pipelines. Add metrics (Prometheus-style) for commitments extracted, evaluations run, interventions created, risk distribution. Export to stdout/OTLP.

tasks.title: Configuration & Environment
tasks.description: Build configuration loader from environment variables. Support DB type, connection strings, risk thresholds, API keys, tick intervals. Validate config at startup. Provide sensible defaults for dev mode.

tasks.title: Docker & Deployment Setup
tasks.description: Create Dockerfile with multi-stage build. Create docker-compose.yml with SQLite/PostgreSQL variants. Add health checks. Ensure non-root user. Document startup procedure.

tasks.title: Build cmd/main Entrypoint
tasks.description: Create the main.go entrypoint that parses config, opens the store, wires all dependencies (pipelines, kernels, worker, gRPC server), and starts the system. Implement graceful shutdown sequence.

tasks.title: End-to-End Smoke Tests
tasks.description: Write a black-box test that starts the full server (memory backend), sends an Extract request, verifies commitment creation, triggers Evaluate, verifies risk update and intervention creation. Clean up between tests.

tasks.title: Production Readiness Review
tasks.description: Run through the production readiness checklist: 12-Factor compliance, graceful shutdown, health checks, resource limits, error handling, secrets management, logging, tracing, metrics. Fix any gaps. Update documentation.
